scientific_finding: The uniform L8 run is adequate for large-scale density/cluster environment diagnostics but cannot resolve MW/M31 halos: a 1e12 Msun/h halo contains only about 3-4 particles.
consequence: Do not claim Local Group reproduction from this catalog. Promote a separately generated zoom IC with <=0.3 cMpc/h LG resolution before MW/M31/M33/HOP gates.
next: Define the LG zoom mask/target coordinate from the CF4 posterior and generate a multi-level zoom IC; retain this L8 run as the parent/environment realization.
